name: Next.js
summary: A React framework for full web apps, with pages and private server code in one project.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Runs anywhere Node.js runs, including your own server or a container, not only on Vercel.

language.note: Written in TypeScript or JavaScript with React components.

has_server_code.note: Route handlers, server components and server actions run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Next.js is a framework for React; pages and components are React components.

setup.step: Create the app with create-next-app and push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Keep secrets in server-only code: route handlers, server components and server actions. Only variables prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_ reach the browser.
